_comment: Hard coded descriptions of well-known ports, software, user accounts, operating systems, and special IP addresses (exact addresses under ips, CIDR ranges under ip-ranges, first match wins). Entries may have a list of external links ({title, source, url}), shown as '"title" on source'; entries may also have a logo (URL of an SVG or PNG); keep it short, 0-5 links, usually 1 or 2. Edit freely; the frontend reads this file at build time.
